description: This class defines a set of GATT (Generic Attribute Profile) attribute UUIDs for Bluetooth LE services and characteristics, and provides a lookup method to retrieve their human-readable names.

classes.name: SampleGattAttributes
classes.description: A utility class that stores GATT attribute UUIDs and their corresponding names for BLE services and characteristics, with a lookup method to retrieve names based on UUID.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name for a given UUID if it exists in the attributes map; otherwise returns the provided default name.
